step.name: Sign in and name the dalal
step.text: Open fabriccost STUDIO, sign in, and name the dalal or broker for the grey fabric job.

step.name: Choose single or multiple yarns
step.text: Pick Single Warp for one warp and one weft, or Multiple Warp / Weft when yarns split by percentage.

step.name: Enter reed, pick, counts and rates
step.text: Speak or type reed, reed space, L2L, warp count, pick, weft count, wastage, yarn rates, sizing rate and pick / dalal rate.

step.name: Read the rupee breakdown
step.text: Calculate to see warp weight (1825), weft weight (1693.33), sizing, dalal line and total. Edit any field and recalculate.

acceptedAnswer.text: A free fabric cost calculator for Indian powerloom grey fabric costing. It works out warp, weft, reed, pick, sizing and job rate from mill-sheet values.

mainEntity.name: Is this a fabric cost calculator for Ichalkaranji mills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Harshvardhan Pareek built fabriccost STUDIO in Ichalkaranji for local powerloom mills. The same grey-fabric formulas are used across India.

mainEntity.name: How does powerloom grey fabric costing work here?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sign in, name the dalal or broker, choose Single Warp or Multiple Warp / Weft, then speak or type reed, pick, counts and rates. Warp weight uses 1825; weft weight uses 1693.33.

mainEntity.name: Who is Harshvardhan Pareek, the maker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Harshvardhan Pareek is the maker of fabriccost STUDIO (Pareektech), based in Ichalkaranji, Maharashtra.

mainEntity.name: Do spoken field prompts need a paid API key?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Speak mode uses free Chrome Web Speech for continuous dictation. Browser speechSynthesis voices (Google, Microsoft or Apple) are optional and stay quiet while you talk. An ElevenLabs key is optional and not required.
